# Orion Home – Professional Cleaning Services in Stockholm

## About

Orion Home is a licensed and fully insured professional cleaning company serving Stockholm, Sweden. Orion Home was started because we believe in cleaning that is done properly, with care for both the home and the people who live in it.

Website: https://www.orionstad.se
Legal entity: Atomus AB (org. nr 559468-1479), trading as Orion Home
Service area: Stockholm, Huddinge, Solna, Sundbyberg, and the greater Stockholm region

## Services

- **Regular home cleaning** — routine maintenance cleaning including dusting, vacuuming, mopping, kitchens, and bathrooms
- **Deep cleaning** — thorough cleaning targeting hard-to-reach areas, inside appliances, behind furniture, and built-up grime
- **Move-in/move-out cleaning** — complete end-of-tenancy or pre-move-in cleaning
- **Office cleaning** — professional cleaning for workplaces and commercial spaces
- **Eco-friendly cleaning** — all services available with non-toxic, sustainable products safe for children, pets, and people with allergies

All services can be booked as a one-time visit or on a recurring basis: weekly, bi-weekly, or monthly.

## Key Facts

- Licensed and fully insured
- All cleaners are background-checked and personally trained in the Orion Home method
- Eco-friendly, non-toxic products used throughout
- 5-star rated service
- 100% satisfaction guarantee — free re-clean within 24 hours if not satisfied
- Same cleaner assigned for every recurring visit (consistency and trust)
- Free quotes via https://www.orionstad.se/contact
- Languages: Swedish, English

## Why Orion Home

For us, quality means being thorough, listening to your wishes and doing work you feel happy with. With personal contact and help with the cleaning, you get more time over and a clean home to enjoy.
